Chinese Documents: Authorities and Price Bands

Every document in China comes from a different office. This hub lists all six with the office that issues it and the observed band, so you can pick the right page before you open a chat.

Price bands differ by document by an order of magnitude and the checks differ completely. Read the office column before the price column, because the office tells you what the document is and the price only tells you what a seller hopes to get for it.

Chinese documents: the six offices

Issuing office by document.
DocumentOfficeObserved
Passportthe Exit and Entry Administration900–3200 CNY
Driving Licencethe Vehicle Management Office600–2400 CNY
ID Cardthe public security bureau450–1700 CNY
Green Cardthe National Immigration Administration1600–5400 CNY
Visaa Chinese embassy750–2700 CNY
Residence Permitthe National Immigration Administration1500–4800 CNY

Two checks specific to China

  • Check the resident identity card for the eighteen digit number and its ISO seven thousand sixty four checksum.
  • Confirm the passport emblem printing and the machine-readable zone.

Local red flag

  • A resident identity card whose eighteen digit number fails the checksum.
